n-k-k4-01.title: Isaziso esifinyeziweyo
n-k-k4-01.goal: Thelekisa ishwankathelo elifutshane lomnye umfundi nesaziso sethala leencwadi, ufumane imigca etshintsha oko isaziso sikuthethayo, uze ulungise omnye wayo.
n-k-k4-01.material:
Umfundi omtsha ubuza 현우 ukuba yintoni imithetho yethala leencwadi lesikolo. 현우 ufunda isaziso esingezantsi abhalele ishwankathelo elifutshane.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.
n-k-k4-01.thinking.1: Ukuthelekisa ikopi nomthombo wayo umgca ngomgca
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: Uyazi 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 kunye 돌려주다
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: Ishwankathelo lika-현우 lisezantsi. Eminye imigca ithi into eyahlukileyo kwisaziso. Khetha omnye wayo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thabatha ishwankathelo umgca omnye ngexesha ufumane umgca ohambelanayo kwisaziso.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye buza: ngaba isaziso sithi kanye oku, okanye ishwankathelo litshintshe usuku, ubude bexesha okanye imeko?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hlola imigca equlathe usuku, inani leentsuku okanye igama elithi 'nawuphi'.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Imigca yesi-2, yesi-5 neyesi-6 ayichanekanga. Isaziso sithi 일요일은 쉽니다 (kuvaliwe ngeCawa), ukungavunyelwa ukuboleka kuhlala kangangeentsuku ezo incwadi yaphoxa ngazo, kwaye kuvunyelwe kuphela ibhotile yamanzi enesivalo. Imigca yoku-1, owesi-3 nowesi-4 ihambelana nesaziso.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Umgca wokugqibela weshwankathelo uvakala ufutshane kwaye unobuhlobo. Kutheni uyingxaki kumfundi omtsha?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Beka umgca wesi-6 ecaleni komgca wokugqibela wesaziso.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana igama elincinci kwisaziso elilinganisa ukuba yimaphi iziselo ezivunyelweyo, ubone ukuba ishwankathelo liligcinile na.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: Uya kucinga ukuba akavumelekanga ukuzisa isiselo kwaphela.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Ishwankathelo alikwaleli iziselo; livumela zonke iziselo, nto leyo eyimpazamo echaseneyo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: Uya kucinga ukuba iziselo ziyavunyelwa ngeentsuku zeveki kuphela.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Ishwankathelo alithi nto ngeentsuku zeziselo. Ingxaki yimeko elahlekileyo yokuba sesiphi isiselo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: Usenokuzisa isiselo esingavunyelwanga, kuba imeko yalahleka.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: Uya kucinga ukuba ithala leencwadi limvumela ukuzisa ukutya kunye neziselo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: Umgca uthetha ngeziselo kuphela; ukutya akukhankanywanga kuwo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Ishwankathelo linokuphosakala ngaphandle kwegama elinye elingalunganga: 아무거나 yasusa imeko (뚜껑이 있는 물병만). Iimeko ezilahlekileyo yindlela eqhelekileyo yokutshintsha umthetho.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Phinda ubhale umgca weziselo (umgca wokugqibela weshwankathelo) ngesiKorean ukuze uthi into enye nesaziso. Sebenzisa intetho enentlonipho ye--요.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Buyela kumgca wokugqibela wesaziso ufumane ukuba ziziphi iziselo ezivunyelweyo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yeyiphi imeko elahlekileyo kumgca weshwankathelo? Yibuyisele.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umgca wam ugcina isivalo kunye nebhotile yamanzi?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umfundi omtsha ofunda umgca wam kuphela wayeza kuzisa into echanekileyo?

n-k-k4-02.title: Ikhekhe lasimahla lomhla wokuzalwa?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Dibanisa iflaya nomyalezo womhlobo, ufumane ukuba ziziphi iinyani ezigqiba ukuba icebo liyasebenza na, uze uxelele umhlobo wakho ukuba enze ntoni.
n-k-k4-02.material:
Namhlanje yi-수요일. Umhlobo wakho 하나 uthumele umyalezo, kwaye ukwanike iflaya yekhefi.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자: "내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게."
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Zeziphi IINTO EZIMBINI zolwazi ezigqiba ukuba icebo lika-하나 liyasebenza? Khetha zombini.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Zeziphi iinyani, xa zithathwa kunye, ezinika umhla?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola inyani nganye: ingaba iyenza icebo lisilele ngaphambi kokuba 하나 afike nasekhefini?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: Usuku lokuzalwa luka-하나 ngoMgqibelo, ngoko umthetho weCawa awunamsebenzi kweli cebo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: Oku kufuneka kwenziwe ekhefini, kodwa akugqibi ukuba icebo lisenako ukusebenza.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Esi sisizathu secebo, hayi umthetho omele uwuhlole.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Umthetho wokuqinisa nosuku lokuzalwa kufuneka zibekwe kunye: usuku lokuzalwa lukaMgqibelo kunye ne-'ukuya kutsho kwiintsuku ezi-3 ngaphambili' linika umhla wokugqibela, kwaye umhla wokugqibela usenokuba sondele.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Sebenzisa umzekelo weflaya. Namhlanje yi-수요일. Kusuku lokuzalwa lukaMgqibelo, yeyiphi imini yokugqibela yokwenza ukuqinisa?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa umzekelo kwiflaya njengepatheni: ukusuka kusuku lokuzalwa, bala emva inani lemihla elifanayo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala iintsuku ngolandelelwano uMgqibelo, uLwesihlanu, uLwesine, ... uyeke kwinani elichanekileyo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: ULwesine ngeentsuku ezi-2 kuphela phambi koMgqibelo, ngoko sele kuphelile.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: ULwesibini ngeentsuku ezi-4 phambi koMgqibelo. Bala ngomzekelo: Usuku lokuzalwa lwangoLwesihlanu lunika uLwesibini.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: ULwesibini luphambi koMgqibelo ngeentsuku ezi-5; umzekelo weflaya (usuku lokuzalwa lwangoLwesihlanu, uLwesibini) ubonisa iintsuku ezi-3 ngaphambili.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Ukusuka uLwesihlanu ukuya kuLwesibini kuyiintsuku ezi-3 ngaphambili, ngoko uMgqibelo ukuya kuLwesithathu kungumgama ofanayo. Namhlanje nguLwesithathu, ngoko namhlanje yimini yokugqibela.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhalela 하나 umbhalo ofutshane ngesiKorean (intetho enobuhlobo ye--요). Mxelele ukuba enze ntoni nokuba ngenxa yentoni, kwaye kutheni.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yitsho into emele ayenze (yintoni, njani) wongeze isizathu nge--아서/어서 okanye -니까.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umbhalo wam uthi namhlanje, ukuba enze ntoni kwaye kutheni?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba 하나 wayeya kwazi ukuba enze ntoni emva kokuwufunda?

n-k-k4-03.title: Amatikiti eqela
n-k-k4-03.goal: Guqula umyalezo womhlobo onomthetho ofihliweyo womlinganiselo ube yimeko ezichanekileyo, wakhe amaqela amaninzi ahambelana, uze uxele elinye ngesiKorean.
n-k-k4-03.material:
Umhlobo wakho 서연 uthumela umyalezo phambi kokuba uthenge amatikiti epaki yokonwaba:

"놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요."

(1만 원 = 10,000원, ngoko 6만 원 = 60,000원. Iqela ngabadala nabantwana obabhalileyo kuphela.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Uyawazi amanani, 명, 어른, 어린이 kunye ne-까지
n-k-k4-03.prereq.2: Uyayazi 만 (10,000) kumaxabiso afana no-3만 8천 원
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: Sithini esi sivakalisi '어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요' kuwe?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokuzama umthetho ngomntu omdala omnye: bangaba bangaphi abantwana abanokuza?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Emva koko zama abantu abadala ababini ubone ukuba inani likhula kanjani.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: Umntu omdala omnye angakwazi ukuhamba nabantwana ababini ubuninzi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Umntu omdala ngamnye kufuneka athathe abantwana ababini ngqo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: '까지' inika umda ophezulu, ayiyontsingiselo yenani elifunekayo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.c: Banokubakho abantwana abalingana kuphela nabantu abadala.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Umthetho uthi abantwana ababini kumntu omdala ngamnye, hayi omnye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Umntwana ngamnye ufuna abantu abadala ababini abahamba naye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: Oko kuguqula umthetho: apha umntu omdala omnye angahamba nabantwana ababini.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' ubeka umda: umntu omdala omnye uthatha abantwana ababini ubuninzi, ngoko ke xa kukho abantu abadala aba-2 banokuhamba abantwana aba-4 ubuninzi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaqela ama-3 anelisa zonke iimeko ezisemyalezweni, elinye ngalinye linenani elahlukileyo labantu abadala. a = abantu abadala, c = abantwana.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala iimeko ngamazwi akho, umgca omnye ngamnye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngo-a = 2 ukhangele amanani abantwana anelisa umthetho wabantwana nomthetho wabantu aba-5.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ubuncinane umntu omdala omnye nomntwana omnye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Kufuneka ubuncinane umntu omdala omnye, kwaye umyalezo uthi ubuncinane umntwana omnye (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Abangabi ngaphezu kwabantwana ababini kumntu omdala ngamnye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukho abantwana abaninzi kakhulu: umntu omdala ngamnye angathatha ababini ubuninzi (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Umyalezo ufuna abantu aba-5 okanye ngaphezulu (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo abantu abadala aba-2 + abantwana aba-3 = 38,000 won; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Amaqela amaninzi ayafaneleka kuba umyalezo unika imida, hayi iqela elinye ngqo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha IQELA ELINYE kumaqela akho uthumele 서연 umyalezo omfutshane ngesiKorean (ngesimo esihloniphekileyo -요): qala ngabantu abadala, emva koko abantwana, kwandule kulandele ixabiso lilonke. Bhala amanani ngeedijithi okanye ngamagama amanani esiKorean.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa iqela elinye elingentla: ngawaphi amanani amabini?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chaza abantu abadala, emva koko abantwana, kwandule kulandele isixa lilonke nge-won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba amanani asemyalezweni wam ayavumelana neqela elinye endiliyakhileyo?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isixa lilonke sibe yi-10,000 × abantu abadala + 6,000 × abantwana?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Onke amanani omabini kunye nesixa lilonke.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: Umzala ka-서연 uthi: '어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.' Esi sicwangciso siyaphula yiphi imeko?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Vavanya isicwangciso ngokuchasene nemeko nganye esemyalezweni, enye ngenye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza ngokwakho ukubala ngalinye; ungathembeli kumanani abhalwe kwisicwangciso.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.a: Kukho abantwana abaninzi kunalo mthetho uvumela.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: Abantu abadala abahlanu bangahamba nabantwana abalishumi ubuninzi, kwaye isicwangciso sinabantwana ababini kuphela.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: Kukho abantu aba-7, ngoko ke umthetho wabantu aba-5 uyanelisekile.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Isicwangciso sinabantwana aba-2, ngoko ke umthetho wobuncinane umntwana omnye uyanelisekile.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Amatikiti enyanisweni axabisa i-62,000 won, ngaphezu komda.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: Abantu abadala abahlanu bayixabisa i-50,000 won, kwaye abantwana ababini bayixabisa i-12,000 won, oko kukuthi i-62,000 won, ngaphezu kwe-60,000. Inani elisesicwangciso belingalunganga. Ngalo lonke ixesha phinda ubale isixa lilonke ngokwakho endaweni yokukopa.

n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k4-04.title: Isipho sesnaku
n-k-k4-04.goal: Funda incoko emfutshane ngamanqanaba, guqula indlela oyifunda ngayo njengoko kufika izivakalisi ezitsha, uze uphendule ukuze kungabikho mntu kufuneka aqashisele.
n-k-k4-04.material: Ukwikhefi yesikolo nomhlobo wakho wasekilasini 지우. Ukhupha ibhegi yeekhrakha.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela amagama anika isizathu okanye ixesha emva kwempendulo yokuqala.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ukuba 지우 uthetha ntoni kakhulu?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Zozibini iindlela zokufunda ziyenzeka: 괜찮아요 inokwamkela okanye ikwale isipho. Impendulo enye emfutshane ayonelanga.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho nto ikhankanya esinye isnaku; uphendula kuphela isipho sakho.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Impendulo yakhe imfutshane kwaye ihloniphekile, ayisosingeniso.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku ucinga ukuba 지우 uthetha ntoni kakhulu?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: '-아서요' inika isizathu. Ukutya okuninzi emini kwenza 'hayi enkosi' ibe yeyona ndlela yokufunda ifanelekileyo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Angathanda ezinye iikhrakha, kuba etye kakhulu emini.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Isidlo sasemini esikhulu sisizathu sokungatyi ngakumbi, ngoko sikhomba ekwaleni.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uphendula ngesizathu esinxulumene nokutya, ngoko ke ulive.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ngoku umfanekiso uphela uyacaca: hayi ngoku, kodwa mhlawumbi ewe kamva. 괜찮아요 yokuqala yodwa ibingenako ukukubonisa oko.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hayi ngoku, kodwa mhlawumbi ikhrakha enye kamva.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ucela enye kamva, ngoko ke akalali ngonaphakade.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ucela enye kuwe kamva, ngoko ufuna uzigcine.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: 괜찮아요 inokuthetha 'ewe, kulungile' okanye 'hayi enkosi'. Amagama alandela ngasemva kwayo (isizathu, ixesha) anquma ukuba yeyiphi. Impendulo ehloniphekileyo isenokungacaci.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo wakho 민호 ukunika isnaku. Yeyiphi impendulo 민호 anokuyiqonda gwenxa lula kakhulu?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buza ngempendulo nganye: emva kokuyifunda, ngaba 민호 uya kwazi ukuba makakunike isnaku ngoku?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ngempendulo nganye kumyalezo wombhalo ongenawo umbilo wezwi: ngaba 민호 angayifunda ngeendlela ezimbini ezichasayo?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: 괜찮아요 yodwa inokuviwa njengokuthi ewe okanye hayi. Ukwala okanye ukwamkela ngegama elicacileyo (안 먹을게요, 주세요) akunakuviwa ngolo hlobo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 ukunika isnaku. Awufuni ngoku, kodwa unokufuna kamva. Phendula ngesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo -요) ukuze 민호 angakuqondi gwenxa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Chaza ngokucacileyo ukuba awusayi kutya ngoku uze unike isizathu esifutshane.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Yongeza isivakalisi esinye ngoko ongenza kamva.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba 민호 uya kwazi ukuba ndithi hayi ngoku?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba 민호 uya kwazi ukuba ndingathi ewe kamva?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Iyala ngoku, inika isizathu, icela kamva.

n-k-k4-05.title: Ndifika ngokuhlwa: icebo elinye, abafundi ababini
n-k-k4-05.goal: Xelela inkosikazi endala nomntakwenu omncinci iindaba ezifanayo, uguqule inqanaba lentetho yesiKorean kwenye nganye.
n-k-k4-05.material: Unolwazi lweklabhu namhlanje kwaye uya kufika ekhaya ngentsimbi yesi-7:00, emva kwexesha eliqhelekileyo. Uya kushiyela umakhulu wakho (할머니) inqaku, kunye nomyalezo womntakwenu omncinci (동생), umsebenzisela 반말.
n-k-k4-05.thinking.1: Ukugcina iindaba ezifanayo kwiindlela ezimbini zokuthetha
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda imiyalezo isivakalisi ngasinye ujonge ukuba sigqitywa kanjani nganye.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela nesenzi esisetyenziswe kwesidlo sangokuhlwa sika-할머니 kunye nezigqibo.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Zombini izivakalisi zigqitywa ngendlela othetha ngayo nomhlobo okanye nomntu omncinci, hayi ku-할머니.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: Isivakalisi sokuqala siwela kwintetho engahloniphekanga (올게); izivakalisi ezimbini azivumelani.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Sihloniphekile, kodwa 먹어요 ayimhloniphi 할머니 njengoko 드세요 yenza kwisidlo sakhe.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: Ku-할머니 sonke isivakalisi sidinga -요 okanye isigqibo esihloniphekileyo, kwaye isidlo sakhe sithatha isenzi esihloniphekileyo 드세요. Izigqibo ezingahloniphekanga (가, 먹어, 올게) zezabahlobo nabantu abancinci, kwaye ukuxuba amanqanaba kwinqaku elinye kuvakala ngathi akukhathalelwanga.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhalela 할머니 inqaku lakho ngesiKorean. Yithi uya kufika ekhaya ngentsimbi yesi-7:00 uze uchaze isizathu.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubiza 할머니, emva koko uchaze ixesha nesizathu.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Gqibezela isivakalisi ngasinye ngesigqibo se--요 okanye -세요.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ndimbizile 할머니 kwaye ndigqibe zonke izivakalisi ngentlonipho?
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku bhala umyalezo womntakwenu omncinci (동생), usebenzisa 반말. Yithi iindaba ezifanayo: uya kufika ekhaya ngentsimbi yesi-7:00. Yongeza into enye ofuna ayenze.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.0: Yithi ixesha elifanayo, kodwa sebenzisa izigqibo ozisebenzisa ku-동생.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.1: Yongeza isicelo esinye esifutshane (먹어, 해 줘, 기다려 ...).
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ithwele iindaba ezifanayo nenqaku elisa ku-할머니?
